interpretation: Independence is reported by the authors for the two corrected locked sets; no contrary inference is made from matching answers.
All positions disclose prior project exposure. This is internal, retrospective, non-memory-blinded agreement, not external validation.
The enriched 663-position set includes a complete-position census and two stratified samples. Its unweighted coefficient is descriptive of this set, not a prevalence or accuracy estimate.
Rater agreement does not establish scientific accuracy or full re-examination of the source package. Source-scoped and cumulative labels are separate.
Repeated positions occur within trials. No binomial confidence interval, independence assumption, external error rate or clinical effect was calculated.
Design weights are retained for reproducibility. Weighted descriptive agreement is shown separately within each stated historical position frame; no error-rate extrapolation is made.
metadata_scope: Report wording and extra reported coverage aggregates; these aggregates are not recomputed from privacy-minimised labels. All agreement cells and label/source coverage are recomputed.
